tree.note: a standing tree: the crown thins out as it is chopped; a stump and chips when felled

old_tree.note: a big old tree: thick dark trunk with roots, a wide dark crown high up

young_tree.note: a sapling: thin pale trunk, small bright crown; branches are taken from it

rock.note: a boulder that breaks into smaller stones as it is mined, rubble when gone

flint_outcrop.note: sharp glassy nodules in a pale bed: one goes with every few blows

copper_vein.note: a grey rock with green streaks of ore: the streaks go as it is mined

clay_bank.note: wet mounds of clay on a muddy bank: they shrink as clay is dug

reed_bed.note: tall reeds with brown heads in a patch of mud: cut one by one

fiber_grass.note: a tuft of tough grass: thinner as fibre is pulled, short stubble when gone

herb_patch.note: a low clump of healing herbs with pale flowers: leaves go as they are picked

berry_bush.note: a round bush; the berries go cluster by cluster as they are picked

fallen_trunk.note: a dead trunk on the ground, cut in two logs: one half goes at a time

rabbit.note: the rabbit's procedural body (the fox is Fox.glb)

axe_stone.note: a stone head lashed to a wooden handle; the handle along +Z (the hand socket's forward)

pick_stone.note: a pick: a long stone point across the handle's end

basket.note: a wicker basket worn on the back

bundle.note: a tied bundle of fibre, reeds or anything else

wheelbarrow.note: a wooden barrow pushed in front: its handles in the hands

meat_bundle.note: the meat of a hunt (H14), carried in the arms tied in its hide

pile_meat.note: meat of the hunts laid on a hide (it spoils fast: the pile shrinks)

spear_flint.note: a long shaft with a knapped flint point lashed on

leather_bag.note: a leather bag worn on the back, tied at the top

pile_hides.note: hides, leather and mats piled flat

pile_logs.note: the store's woodpile: one more log for every few units

pile_berries.note: berry baskets: one more basket for every few units

pile_crates.note: anything else the store keeps: crates

plot_sprout.note: sprouts that rise through the stage

plot_grown.note: a ripe crop (grain): golden stalks with heads

plot_frost.note: winter frost over a plot (what is sown, sprouting or ripe is ruined by it)

shelter.note: a round hut: a ring of stakes, poles leaning to the top, wattle walls, a thatched cone

storage.note: a raised store: posts, a platform, plank walls, a pitched thatch roof

workbench.note: a split-log bench to work at, with a stone anvil and tools

drying_rack.note: two forked posts, crossbars and strips of berries and meat hung to dry

kiln.note: a ring of stones, a clay dome over it and a short chimney

palisade.note: a section of wall: sharpened stakes, then the binding rails

hut.note: a round wattle-and-daub hut: stone footing, a ring of posts, plastered walls with a doorway, a thick thatched cone

longhouse.note: a long timber hall: stone footings, two rows of posts and a ridge beam, wattle walls daubed with clay, a pitched roof of reed and mats

cache_pit.note: a pit dug in the ground, ringed with stones, lined and covered with a woven reed lid

granary.note: a granary on stilts with stone caps against the mice, wattle walls and a thatched cone

hearth.note: the communal hearth: a wide ring of stones, logs on the embers, a spit and stones to sit on

smoking_rack.note: a frame of poles over a smouldering fire, meat hung on the bars, covered with reeds to keep the smoke in

hide_frame.note: a soaking pit and a frame with a hide stretched on it by cords, a scraper on the ground

healer_hut.note: a small reed hut with bundles of herbs hung at the door and a bench of remedies

totem.note: the clan's meeting place: a circle of stones round a carved, painted pole

forge.note: a brick furnace with a clay chimney, and a hide bellows pumped by hand beside it
